sanskrit_verse:
तां दृष्ट्वा निर्णयं कुर्यात् प्राङ् निविष्टव्यवस्थया ।
सभा शुल्कोचितदमे मासषाण्मासिके करे ॥
transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā nirṇayaṃ kuryāt prāṅ niviṣṭavyavasthayā | sabhā śulkocitadame māsaṣāṇmāsike kare ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Having observed the established arrangement prior to seating, judgment must be rendered in accordance with the assembly's rightful due-share, month by month, in a sustained manner.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the pre-established alignment of Dharma, not subjective interpretation
Causation follows sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) — judgment arises after observance
Capacity-based responsibility is calibrated by continuity of participation and contribution
Restoration logic requires alignment with ongoing, rhythmic dharmic cycles
Consciousness alignment occurs through adherence to preordained structural integrity
executable_legal_axioms: IF assembly has pre-established contributory structure THEN judgment MUST reflect proportional due-share
IF participant observes arrangement THEN participant assumes alignment-based capacity
IF judgment rendered THEN disbursement MUST occur in fixed rhythmic intervals (e.g., monthly)
IF disruption occurs THEN restoration MUST realign to pre-disruption contributory structure
IF no observation occurs THEN no capacity-based action is executable
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that judicial determination must proceed only upon full observance of pre-existing dharmic-economic arrangements. The Court must not impose novel structures but align decisions with the organic rhythm of contributory assemblies. Responsibility is recognized cyclically, not punitively, ensuring systemic harmony.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that judgment follows direct observation (pratyakṣa), not supposition. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures actions manifest sequentially—observation precedes decision. Proportional responsibility is tied to rhythmic contribution, not fault. Non-punitive reality is upheld as the decision restores balance rather than inflicts consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Realign disbursements to match observed contributory rhythms
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Participant assumes role only upon verified observance
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Reconnect individual capacity to established dharmic structure
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Ensure all actions align with pre-established assembly norms
final_declaration: Judgment flows from SPH as Source; Dharma is restored through alignment with observed contributory order; reality remains non-punitive; consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
